title: otel/ adapter sends kbmon's events as OTLP log records
goal: otel/kbmon_otel.py sends each record of kbmon --events as an OTLP log record with its event name, time and id-only attributes to /v1/logs, keeping the cursor in memory between rounds

clauses.clause: otel/kbmon_otel.py sends each record of kbmon --events as an OTLP log record with its event name, time and id-only attributes to /v1/logs, keeping the cursor in memory between rounds

gates.question: How do the adapter's event records relate to --panel, --from-snapshot and severity?
Are event records sent whenever a logs endpoint is set, and does a failed send keep the cursor?

notes: Plan 2026-10-18 (operator interview): events go as log records and spans, not metrics only.
